info.name: ALOud REST API v1 - 102 Complete Endpoints
info.description:
Complete test collection for ALOud e-commerce platform REST API

**Setup Instructions:**

1. Import this collection into Postman
    
2. Set the base URL in the collection variables: `http://localhost:5021`
    
3. For admin endpoints, add your JWT token to the `token` variable
    
4. Run the collection in Postman Test Runner

**Features Covered:**
- Admin Dashboard & Config (4 endpoints)
- Authentication & User Management (6 endpoints)
- Catalog Management - CRUD (57 endpoints)
- Perfumes Operations (11 endpoints)
- Address Management (7 endpoints)
- Checkout Operations (15 endpoints)
- Order Management (12 endpoints)
- Stock Management (7 endpoints)
- AI & Chat Features (4 endpoints)
